subject: POC provisioning cadence & close timeline (API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma@pulsehealth.com>, it-team@pulsehealth.com
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC provisioning cadence & close timeline (API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering)

Hi Emma / PulseHealth infra team,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — we outlined a compact mutual action plan to get your POC running against a production-like environment by the 2-week close window. To keep things tight I laid out the critical path below and flagged owners. Please confirm acceptance or call out any blockers by EOD Monday so we can lock calendars.

Critical path (minimum required to start the POC):
- Redwood org creation + admin invite (owner: PulseHealth) — we provide the template invite.
- API key provisioning (owner: Redwood) — scoped to staging POC, TTL 30 days, revocation procedure included.
- IP allowlist for staging endpoints (owner: PulseHealth) — we need CIDR entries for your NAT/GW and any egress IPs.
- VPC peering (owner: PulseHealth infra & Redwood infra) — peering requires a short maintenance window to validate routing and health checks.

Proposed dates:
- Org invite sent: Aug 8
- API keys issued (staging): Aug 9 morning PT
- IP allowlist applied & smoke tests: Aug 9 afternoon PT
- VPC peering scheduled/handshake: Aug 10 14:00 PT (30-min window)

Attachments: I attached a one-page MAP (MAP-PulseHealth-v1.pdf) and a sample CSV for the allowlist. Naomi, can you also include the standard peering checklist?

Next steps / asks from PulseHealth please:
1) Provide the list of egress CIDRs that need to be whitelisted (reply to this thread or upload the CSV to the Drive link).
2) Confirm the VPC ID and preferred peering window (we suggested Aug 10 14:00 PT).
3) Identify at least one admin to accept the Redwood org invite (email).

We will keep the API keys scoped, logged, and rotate-able; full KMS integration is an optional follow-up if you need customer-managed keys.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Emma Liu <emma@pulsehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: it-team@pulsehealth.com, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-07T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC provisioning cadence & close timeline (API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering)

Jordan — thanks, this looks clear. Quick confirmations from our side:
- Org admin: Emma Liu (emma@pulsehealth.com) will accept the invite.
- Egress CIDRs: attaching preliminary list; final authoritative list by Aug 9 10:00 PT.
- VPC: pulse-vpc-prod-2 (we're ok with Aug 10 14:00 PT, but prefer a 45-min window in case routes need tweaks).

We have a short internal compliance review on keys — we need the API keys to be limited to staging endpoints and expire after 30 days (sounds like your default). Naomi, can you confirm the revocation path?

Emma
Emma Liu
Infrastructure Lead, PulseHealth

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma@pulsehealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-08T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC provisioning cadence & close timeline (API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering)

Thanks Emma — we will: 
- Send the org invite by EOD today (Aug 8).
- Generate a scoped staging API key on Aug 9 09:00 PT and share the key metadata (key id, scopes, TTL). We will NOT email the raw secret; we will provide a secure one-time retrieval link (DocSecurity) and log issuance in the console.
- Revocation path: any admin on your org can revoke a key from the Console; additionally Redwood support can revoke on request if you provide the key id.

On VPC peering: Marissa will handle the ops runbook and handshake. Karthik — can you confirm route table and CIDR translation notes for pulse-vpc-prod-2 so we can include them in the peering request?

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Emma Liu <emma@pulsehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-09T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC provisioning cadence & close timeline (API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering)

Emma / team — quick network notes to avoid surprises during peering: 
- Please confirm whether you use overlapping /16 or /24 segments on any transit gateways; overlapping CIDs will require NAT on our side.
- We need the specific subnet CIDRs you plan to expose via peering (not just VPC-wide). If you can provide the route table IDs that will accept the peer route, include those in the CSV.
- If your VPC uses AWS PrivateLink for service endpoints, let us know so we can recommend retention policies for flow logs.

I'll draft the peering request template and push to the Drive folder referenced in the MAP. Marissa, can you own the peering test plan and post the health-check checklist?

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Infra / Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma@pulsehealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-10T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC provisioning cadence & close timeline (API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering)

All — quick status update and final checklist before the peering window tomorrow: 
- Org invite was accepted by Emma on Aug 8 14:07 PT.
- API key was generated and a secure retrieval link was posted to PulseHealth's admin account on Aug 9 09:05 PT (key id: kd_09f7, secret delivered via one-time link).
- PulseHealth sent the allowlist CSV; Naomi validated the formatting and asked for one extra egress IP (we noted 52.24.101.33). Please confirm if that IP is allowed or if we should skip.
- VPC peering is scheduled Aug 11 14:00 PT (we pushed one day to give you the extra validation window). ICS invite attached (vpc-peering-window.ics).

Final asks before handover:
1) Emma — confirm the single extra IP (52.24.101.33) or tell us to omit.
2) PulseHealth infra — please make sure your on-call (ops@pulsehealth.com) is on the peering call.

Once peering is complete we will run a scripted smoke test (connect, sample inference, KV cache hit checks) and hand the POC to your product team for evaluation. If all smoke tests pass, we will mark the MAP milestone as "POC ready" and proceed to feature validation.

Thanks, team — see you on the call tomorrow.

Marissa Cole
Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
attachments: MAP-PulseHealth-v1.pdf, network-allowlist.csv, vpc-peering-window.ics
